Every time you buy bacon, ribs, or pork chops, some of that money may ultimately help fund one of Big Pork’s most powerful lobbying groups. 

A new analysis of financial documents obtained by Vox found that since the early 2000s, the National Pork Board — which legally can’t use its funds for lobbying — has moved $66 million into the National Pork Producers Council, a lobbying organization. 

Read the full story: https://www.vox.com/future-perfect/499438/pork-checkoff-usda-board-producers-council

snippet.description:
Are your PSIR answers actually answering what UPSC is asking?

In this PSIR Mentorship Programme orientation lecture, Chandan Kumar Sir breaks down the common answer writing mistakes that aspirants often make and how to avoid them.

From understanding the demand of the question to improving structure, presentation and analytical depth, this session focuses on what can make your PSIR answers more effective for UPSC Mains.

If you are preparing for PSIR Optional for UPSC CSE 2027, this session can help you rethink the way you write your answers.
